description: List the revisions of a Helm release (chart version, status and description of each) in the current or provided namespace

max.description: Maximum number of most recent revisions to return (Optional, all if not provided)

namespace.description: Namespace of the Helm release (Optional, current namespace if not provided)

name: helm_history
title: Helm: History

unbounded.reason: Permissions depend on resources contained in the referenced Helm chart

description: Install (deploy) a Helm chart to create a release in the current or provided namespace

chart.description: Chart reference to install (for example: stable/grafana, oci://ghcr.io/nginxinc/charts/nginx-ingress)

name.description: Name of the Helm release (Optional, random name if not provided)

namespace.description: Namespace to install the Helm chart in (Optional, current namespace if not provided)

values.description: Values to pass to the Helm chart (Optional)

name: helm_install
title: Helm: Install

description: List all the Helm releases in the current or provided namespace (or in all namespaces if specified)

all_namespaces.description: If true, lists all Helm releases in all namespaces ignoring the namespace argument (Optional)

namespace.description: Namespace to list Helm releases from (Optional, all namespaces if not provided)

name: helm_list
title: Helm: List

unbounded.reason: Permissions depend on resources contained in the Helm release

description: Roll back a Helm release to a previous revision in the current or provided namespace

name.description: Name of the Helm release to roll back

namespace.description: Namespace of the Helm release (Optional, current namespace if not provided)

revision.description: Revision to roll back to (Optional, the previous revision if not provided). See helm_history

name: helm_rollback
title: Helm: Rollback

unbounded.reason: Permissions depend on resources contained in the installed Helm release

description: Uninstall a Helm release in the current or provided namespace

name.description: Name of the Helm release to uninstall

namespace.description: Namespace to uninstall the Helm release from (Optional, current namespace if not provided)

name: helm_uninstall
title: Helm: Uninstall

unbounded.reason: Permissions depend on resources contained in the referenced Helm chart

description: Upgrade an existing Helm release to a chart version and/or new values in the current or provided namespace. By default the release's current values are kept and the provided values are merged over them (like helm upgrade --reuse-values)

chart.description: Chart reference to upgrade to (for example: stable/grafana, oci://ghcr.io/nginxinc/charts/nginx-ingress, https://example.com/charts/app-1.2.3.tgz)

name.description: Name of the Helm release to upgrade

namespace.description: Namespace of the Helm release (Optional, current namespace if not provided)

reuse_values.description: Keep the release's current values and merge the provided values over them (Optional, default true). If false, only the chart defaults plus the provided values are used

values.description: Values to set on the release (Optional). Merged over the current values unless reuse_values is false

version.description: Chart version to upgrade to, for repository and OCI references (Optional, latest if not provided)

name: helm_upgrade
title: Helm: Upgrade
